Gain 1 Overguard for every 100 Damage dealt to an enemy's Overguard.
Deals x8 Extra Damage to Overguard.

secondary-irradiate.name: Secondary Irradiate
secondary-irradiate.description: On hitting enemies afflicted by 10 stacks of Radiation: Deal 180% of the hit damage to enemies within 7m.

secondary-kinship.name: Secondary Kinship
secondary-kinship.description: While Buffing Ally Warframes: +20% Critical Chance per buff

secondary-merciless.name: Secondary Merciless
secondary-merciless.description:
On Kill:
+30% Damage for 4s. Stacks up to 12x.
+30% Reload Speed

secondary-outburst.name: Secondary Outburst
secondary-outburst.description: On swapping to Secondary Weapon, consume all Combo Multipliers to increase Secondary Weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage by 20% per Combo consumed for 30s.

secondary-shiver.name: Secondary Shiver
secondary-shiver.description: Enemies take +45% damage per Cold Status

secondary-surge.name: Secondary Surge
secondary-surge.description: On Ability Cast: Next shot gains a Damage Multiplier for every 200 current Energy, up to x8.

shotgun-vendetta.name: Shotgun Vendetta
shotgun-vendetta.description:
On shotgun kill within 5m of target:
+180% Multishot and +75% Reload Speed for 15s.

theorem-contagion.name: Theorem Contagion
theorem-contagion.description: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane creates a globe that orbits the player every 2s. The globes will strike the nearest enemy within 15m dealing 150 damage increasing their vulnerability to the globe's damage type by 200% for 6s. Globes will persist for 30s upon leaving the zone.

theorem-demulcent.name: Theorem Demulcent
theorem-demulcent.description: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases weapon damage by 12%/s stacking up to 15x. Effect persists for 20s upon leaving the zone.

theorem-infection.name: Theorem Infection
theorem-infection.description: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases damage of companions and summoned allies within 90m by 24%/s stacking up to 15x. Effect persists for 20s upon leaving the zone.

6% Status chance for all Warframe weapons for each enemy hit with Tauron Strike, up to 300%. Buff lasts for 30s
+18% Tauron Strike Initial Charge.
